site.title: Youtube
site.short_description: Video channel — About links and descriptions for massive reach.
site.long_description: YouTube channel profiles can link to your site. Confirm rel on your channel About tab. Open YouTube Studio.

opportunities.title: Personal Channel About links
opportunities.description: On your personal YouTube channel (founder or creator account), add your site in channel About and custom links. See channel links help. Good when you build in public under your own name.

steps.body: Open YouTube Studio for your personal channel → Customization → Basic info / Links.
steps.title: Open YouTube Studio

steps.body: Enter your homepage and allowed custom links, then save—confirm on the public channel About tab.
steps.title: Add your site

opportunities.title: Brand channel About links
opportunities.description: On your brand YouTube channel (separate from your personal creator login), add your primary website in channel About and custom links. See add links to your channel banner and profile.

steps.body: Open YouTube Studio → Customization → Basic info / Links.
steps.title: Open YouTube Studio

steps.body: Enter your homepage and any allowed custom links in YouTube Studio, then save—see Google’s channel links help.
steps.title: Add your site

opportunities.title: Video description link
opportunities.description: Place your URL in the description of a video (top lines help visibility). Upload on YouTube or schedule through OpenQuok when your channel is connected.

steps.body: Write title, description with your URL near the top, and metadata in YouTube Studio. Make sure the video content is high quality and human-edited. Otherwise, your channel will be banned
steps.title: Draft the video

steps.body: Upload in YouTube Studio or schedule via OpenQuok for coordinated releases.
steps.title: Publish or schedule
